name: MIRO-CORP-RETREAT-001 Corporate Retreat
description: A multi-network corporate investigation lab adapted from StratoCyberLab's Miro campaign. Start from a public camera, gain command execution, pivot through vulnerable Webmin routers, inspect internal records and proxy logs, and recover staged investigation flags.
hint: Start from the exposed camera HTTP service. Its client-side admin code hides credentials; the authenticated shell is enough to map the auxiliary network and reach the first router.
